object.attr: derived: an agent reads a target in one call and links to it in another, so the commit it read is what the new link has to record (CF-T40). Open question Q6 extended to creating links. Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: The MCP server's add_link, new_object and update_object tools shall accept with each link to create the full hash of the target's commit that the agent read.
